blurb: JAMZ Dance Studio offers dance instruction in a safe, supportive, and positive environment. Programs include Ballet, Jazz, Hip Hop, and Creative Movement for ages 2-6. The studio is owned and directed by Giana Krieger, focusing on high-quality training to help dancers reach their full potential.
